summary: Tested the 'Use Schedule' toggle feature for switching channels to synchronized 24-hour schedule mode. Found and fixed 2 bugs: (1) use_schedule was missing from channel creation in backend, (2) Frontend LiveTV.jsx had a variable shadowing bug where isScheduledChannel wasn't correctly checking the use_schedule flag. All tests now pass.

fixed.issue: use_schedule field was missing from channel_doc during creation - now fixed

Variable shadowing bug - isScheduledChannel was defined as a function but also as a local variable checking schedules instead of use_schedule flag. Changed to isCurrentChannelScheduled and properly checks currentChannel?.use_schedule
Channel list was not including use_schedule property from schedule data

passed_tests: Backend: Admin login works with provided credentials
Backend: GET /api/channels returns channels with use_schedule field
Backend: POST /api/channels creates channel with use_schedule=true (after fix)
Backend: use_schedule defaults to false when not specified
Backend: PUT /api/channels/{id} correctly toggles use_schedule on
Backend: PUT /api/channels/{id} correctly toggles use_schedule off
Backend: GET /api/schedule/live returns use_schedule flag for each channel
Backend: Existing channels can be toggled and verified
Backend: Hush Music Radio has use_schedule=true as expected
Frontend: Dashboard shows 'LIVE' badge for channels with use_schedule=true
Frontend: Dashboard edit form includes 'Live Schedule' toggle
Frontend: Live TV page shows 'LIVE' badge (red) for scheduled channels
Frontend: Live TV page shows 'PLAYING' badge (green) for non-scheduled channels
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Added use_schedule to channel_doc in create_channel endpoint (line 314)
/app/frontend/src/pages/LiveTV.jsx - Fixed isScheduledChannel variable shadowing bug, renamed to isCurrentChannelScheduled
/app/frontend/src/pages/LiveTV.jsx - Fixed channel list to include use_schedule property from schedule data
seed_data_creation: N/A - Used existing Hush Music Radio channel
context_for_next_testing_agent: The use_schedule toggle feature is now fully functional. Hush Music Radio has use_schedule=true and shows LIVE badge. Other channels show PLAYING badge. The frontend correctly differentiates between scheduled and non-scheduled channels both in Dashboard (LIVE badge in channel list) and Live TV page (LIVE vs PLAYING indicator).
